short: A Spartan-led military coalition of Peloponnesian city-states that served as the primary counterweight to Athenian hegemony.
full:
Formed as Sparta secured its dominance over the Peloponnese, the League was an alliance system rather than a unified empire. Member states remained independent and paid no tribute in peacetime, but swore an oath to have the same friends and enemies as Sparta and to provide troops under Spartan command during times of war.

The League successfully contained the rise of Argos and became the backbone of Greek resistance during the Persian Wars. It later served as the primary instrument of Spartan power against Athens in the Peloponnesian War, but eventually fractured and collapsed in the fourth century BCE following Sparta's devastating defeat by Thebes at the Battle of Leuctra.
